description: §7.6 rule (b) (S483 q8-fu) — initializers inside `if=` content that cannot trap stay legal and run: a `%` by a `number` divisor (`7.5 % y`, y: number) and a literal `repeat` on a const holding a short literal (`s.repeat(3)`).
rationale: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S483-q8-division: "inside a construct refuse only what can actually trap: keep `%` and integer division by a possibly-zero int refused; `/` on a `number` divisor is accepted (gives ±∞/NaN, no trap)" — a `%` by a `number` gives NaN by 0 and owes no trap (#2129 r1 review LOW-1). A literal `repeat` count whose result is provably within the longest string cannot trap (#2129 r1 review MED-1).
